goal: Generate and verify a full-scale visual-novel studio through the reviewed Provider route, including distinct self-generated backgrounds and character sprites, a persistent editable branching story tree, asset-to-node binding, design quality, runtime, browser, media, and test evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Background and character-sprite generation are separate executable workflows that create distinct decodable image artifacts from user prompts and expose honest local-model or hosted-provider configuration checks.
Generated assets can be selected by characters or scenes and attached to story nodes without duplicating the story model in frontend and backend modules.

Generated-project unit, contract, integration, runtime, browser, accessibility, media-decoding, and design-quality checks pass or produce an evidence-backed canonical blocker rather than a false success.
The generated project contains docs-first product, architecture, interaction, image-generation, story-schema, quality, and test documentation plus a modular src and tests layout.
The test uses the existing reviewed Provider component route with design research, bounded librarian context, module validation, post-build finalization, and no alternate generator.
Users can create, edit, connect, branch, delete, persist, reload, and preview story nodes through one typed story-tree model.

prevention: Confirm acceptance, interfaces, and applicable kernel constraints before implementation.
assurance: Review method, schema, skill, and repository instruction consistency.
Validate that support artifacts cannot authorize formal delivery PASS.
Review changed files against the kernel contract before integration.
control: Run targeted kernel and knowledge tests.
improvement: Record review findings and one bounded improvement experiment.

interface_expectations: Checkpoint reuse revalidates constructor-injected Python interfaces, safe execution, the nonempty application stage graph, uniform stage-result mappings, and structured artifact storage before a component can feed downstream generation.

Generated-project post-build executes demo.run_fixture through the bounded command runner and routes multi-root failures to exact traceback, media, fixture, and orchestrator owners without adding a generation or delivery path.
The Codex conversation Provider mainline, whiteboard and agent session, local_packager delivery exit, and public delivery gate remain unchanged.

feedback: 242 targeted provider, kernel, routing, project-management, design, complexity, runtime, and architecture tests passed; 150 environment-gated cases were skipped.

The strengthened current-contract validator replayed against the VN backend cache and rejected 13 concrete defects, including an empty stage graph, invalid stage result shapes, missing receiver methods, unsafe eval, executable placeholders, and opaque artifact storage.

The live resumed VN run proved cache invalidation and precise fixture repair routing, but the supplied provider credential returned HTTP 403 Key usage limit exceeded before regenerated leaves could be completed.
The candidate remains NEEDS_REWORK: its generated suite reported 4 passed and 6 failed, all seven required stage artifacts were absent, and no decoder-valid PNG was produced.

worked: Manifest-aware cache validation found architectural incompatibilities before trusting historical PASS checkpoints, while the bounded librarian and modular leaf graph remained intact.
Executing the generated fixture converted vague visual claims into exact artifact, PNG, alpha, and stage-graph evidence and exposed repair ownership precisely.
did_not_work: The earlier syntax-and-symbol-only cache gate accepted semantically disconnected modules, and the earlier post-build compiler truncated multi-root failures to a generic three-file prefix or suppressed model repairs when a deterministic symptom coexisted.
The supplied API key had no remaining usage allowance, so the invalidated backend leaves could not be regenerated and final browser/media acceptance could not run.
experiments: Resume this exact run with a rotated funded credential under hybrid_safe, verify that only invalidated/evidenced leaves regenerate, and compare first-pass fixture and browser acceptance against this blocked baseline.
